refusals.case: an opening message the CLI cannot take
refusals.says: Mute CLI takes no opening message on its command line, so this one would be dropped without a word. Start it and say it in the session instead.

refusals.case: a second process on a conversation the agent will not share
refusals.says: "Earlier work" is already running in Karmashala. Antigravity will not resume a conversation that another process is already writing to — two writers would corrupt its transcript. Close it wherever it is open and try again, or start a new session in this repository.

refusals.case: a conversation the store has never held
refusals.says: "Promised" cannot be resumed: Claude Code has no record of this conversation, so there is nothing to resume. The session reserved its id when it started but the agent never wrote a transcript for it — which is what a session nothing was ever said in looks like, and what a launch that failed leaves behind. No work has been lost. Start a new session in this repository. (conversation id s-711)
Agent-spawned sessions are limited to 2 levels deep and this would be level 4. Do the work in this session instead of delegating it further.

refusals.case: an external launch with no terminal configured
refusals.says: Bad state: No external terminal is configured.

refusals.case: a restart of a session that is gone
refusals.says: Bad state: This session no longer exists.

refusals.case: a restart of a session with no conversation yet
refusals.says: Bad state: Claude Code has not named a conversation for this session yet, so restarting it would open a new conversation instead of continuing this one.
